description: This HTML file defines the front-end interface for a database visualizer dashboard, including styling and client-side JavaScript for dynamic data loading and interaction with backend API endpoints.
external_files: API endpoints referenced in fetch calls: /api/databases, /api/{db}/tables, /api/{db}/tables/{table}/data

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets UI states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database's table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table and renders it.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates HTML for a data table with data rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual table cell, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long strings or objects.
